data.split: VALIDATION of split_for_seed('combat-transition-model-v1:{seed}') 80/10/10, the #418 split the artifact was trained with (TRAIN/VALIDATION/TEST by source seed); TEST never read
data.rows: main corpus 59,282 rows / 3,124 seeds (= §470 extract); importance set 57,790 rows served directly by the fast child (392 Entropic Brew rows go to the standard child, 1,110 active-Lizard rows are composed)
data.forced_slices_not_used: lizard_fairy 1,350, lizard_brew 1,837, ritual_writhing 993, high_maxhp 188 VALIDATION rows extracted but not scored
data.act4: no Act-4 rows exist in the Stage 1 corpus (acts 1-3 only)

metric_definitions.surv: per-row BCE of death prob with the deployed §470 boss death-logit shift -0.18325 (primary)
metric_definitions.maxhp: CE of observed maxHP delta class, wins (training loss)
metric_definitions.hp: CE of observed signed HP class given true delta class and smokeBombUsed, wins (training loss)
metric_definitions.hp_mae: |E[post HP] - post HP| in HP points, wins, marginal over delta with escape mixture as calculateForecastExpectation
metric_definitions.potion: CE of observed potion clear-mask, wins without Smoke Bomb/Entropic Brew whose post inventory equals pre minus cleared slots (54,642 rows)

method.permutation: one row permutation per group per repeat applied to every column/token block of the group; 5 repeats for groups, 3 for singles and token-field shuffles; structural arguments (HP legality, potion-head inventory, escape eligibility, boss shift) keep true values
method.token_field_shuffle: one field of a token type (e.g. card upgraded) pooled across all valid tokens of all held-out rows and permuted, keeping deck/relic sizes and ids
method.ci: source-seed cluster bootstrap, 1,000 resamples, of the per-row delta averaged over repeats
